questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.**

His brother needed some urgent help at that moment.

options.text: Some urgent help was needed by his brother at that moment.
Urgent help was needed by his brother at that moment.
Some urgent help is needed by his brother at that moment.
Some urgent help was needed by his brother at this moment.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Some urgent help was needed by his brother at that moment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **active voice**, the **subject performs the action**.
 
• In this case, "**His brother**" is the **subject**, and "**needed**" is the **action**.
 
• **Active structure**: Subject + Verb + Object__
 __
 
• **Example**: *The chef prepared a delicious meal for the guests.*
 
 
 
• In the **passive voice**, the **focus shifts** from the **doer** of the action **to the receiver** of the action.
 
• **Passive structure**: Object (Receiver of the action) + to be verb + Past participle of the verb + Subject (Agent)__
 
 
• **Example**: *A delicious meal was prepared for the guests by the chef.*
 
 
 
• Here, for the given sentence "**Some urgent help**" becomes the **subject**, and the **verb **is expressed in the **past participle form**, which is "**was needed**."
 
• The agent (the doer of the action) is introduced with "**by his brother**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
